name: Potential1200
author: PotentialBreaks
summary: 12-bit drum sampler in the late-80s style: 8 faders and 8 pads, one-shots from your folders or a break cut to 2 bars from a kick on the 1, taken at 26 kHz into 12 bits with drop-sample pitch, the 45 > 33 trick, the classic per-pad filters and MULTI PITCH. Saves an MPC drum program. Four looks, its own Vintage look first.
